# scripts/UI/StealthHUD.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/UI/StealthHUD.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Player HUD built in code: prompts, lightgem, speech/awareness, health, combat feedback, dazzle, death, and pause settings.
setup() binds the player and its component signals. Small Control subclasses draw individual indicators.
Awareness/layout query methods expose current presentation for tests and callers.

Base: `CanvasLayer`. Registered class: `none`.

### _update_words

```gdscript
func _update_words(marks: Array, speaker: Dictionary, now: float, delta: float) -> void
```

[Source:1344](../../../../../scripts/UI/StealthHUD.gd#L1344)

The words beside a mark (see the header): what they say changes with what
the man does about you (or whose they are), once the change has lasted
WORDS_SETTLE (at once for the first of them to have you, or with nothing
shown); they show for WORDS_HOLD after (longer while his ring climbs, or
while he is the first to have you), then fade; faded in again when they
change.
